subject: standing at the edge of a sinkhole in open upland grass and looking down into it: a ragged round hole torn in the turf, its rim of broken grass, exposed brown soil and dangling roots, the rough grey rock walls of the shaft dropping away steeply to a floor of broken rubble and loose stones in shadow far below. Pale overcast daylight on the grass around the rim. No rope, no ladder, no people.
